body:
# Coins Mod — adds 18 types of coins and their piles to the game!

![All mod items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b81edeced538d8a2709eefd5f06dd28274ccec7d.png)  
![All mod items in creative mode inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81b1e79efd3659d1177614e185623cb53e5b206a.png)  
![Example of exchanging a pile of coins for 9 coins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd9b588c9c8f72fcfc6cf5a735eebcb1df06e821.png)  
![Example of exchanging 9 coins for a pile](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb17f5a28eaf30b250fd626a9493d886f9127952.png)

## 🪙 Coins made of different materials
- copper  
- iron  
- gold  
- emerald  
- diamond  
- platinum  
- netherite  
- amethyst  
- zinc  
- lapis 
- quartz  
- redstone  
- ender coins  
- brass  
- prismarine  
- ice  
- obsidian  
- echo coins  

And a **special rainbow coin (DirtCoin)**, the use of which you can come up with yourself!

## 📦 Coin piles
**Compact storage**:  
- **9 coins → 1 pile**  
- **1 pile → 9 coins**

All items have their own textures, Russian and English translations.  
A separate creative tab **«Coins»** with convenient sorting.

**Fully compatible with Fabric 1.21.11.**

---

## 🔧 Recipes
- **9 coins → 1 pile** (in a crafting table, 3×3)  
- **1 pile → 9 coins** (in any crafting slot)

---

## 📥 Download
Requires **Fabric API**.  
Minecraft version: **1.21.11**.

Developed by **ar1emq** - member of **THEMIDNIGHTCORE** organization.
